home.paragraph: Full-stack software engineer working with JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP and Python. I spent five years at Rocket.Chat building front-end features for an open-source communication platform used by millions, including the Omnichannel suite and reusable UiKit components. I'm pursuing a bachelor's degree in Internet Systems Technology at IFRS and value collaboration and innovation.

ducon.title: Ducon Corretora de Seguros
highlights: Modernized legacy insurance systems with React and Laravel.
Containerized legacy applications with Docker, simplifying deployment and infrastructure management.
Improved deployment reliability by migrating applications to VPS environments.
Built CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions to automate builds and deployments.
Maintained CMS-driven websites with the marketing and product teams.
ducon.website_link: Ducon Corretora de Seguros website (opens in new tab)

rocket_chat.title: Rocket.Chat
highlights: Delivered frontend features for a communication platform serving 12M+ users.
Led the JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration of large frontend modules, modernizing about 30% of the codebase.
Reviewed 300+ pull requests, raising code quality and engineering standards across the frontend.
Resolved 30+ critical Omnichannel issues, improving platform stability and customer experience.
Built 5 reusable UiKit components for Rocket.Chat marketplace apps, giving third-party developers consistent, extensible building blocks.
Mentored frontend engineers through code reviews and technical guidance, spreading TypeScript adoption across multiple squads.
Expanded automated tests and shared component patterns with React Testing Library and Jest, improving reliability and accessibility.
Defined scalable frontend architecture with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver complex UI initiatives.

canopus.title: Canopus
highlights: Delivered 10+ custom web applications for enterprise and public-sector clients, focused on security and business process automation.
Maintained and evolved a legacy platform serving 50,000+ users, shipping new features and production fixes.
Developed financial features, including boleto (Brazilian bank slip) generation, reporting, and payment workflows.
